claims: Clean worktrees run worker and validation commands through existing root runtime without creating venv, symlink, untracked setup file, or installing dependencies

Supervisor tick takes one OS lock (fcntl.flock), deterministically selects eligible active initiatives by ID order, launches at most 2 canonical runs per tick, returns truthful receipts with locked/launched/skipped status
Duplicate concurrent ticks cannot acquire lock and return 'locked' receipt; duplicate sequential ticks launch nothing because tasks are already claimed
Supervisor CLI exposes fixed tick/status commands; launchd generation uses RunAtLoad=true, StartInterval=900, no KeepAlive, safe PATH, canonical root, fixed logs; tests do not install the service

Claude adapter supports strict worker (Sonnet) and reviewer (Opus) contracts with fake CLI tests, no fallback on model failure, exit 75 for unavailable executable/auth with no output/change, reviewer immutability check
Builder remains the only durable authority; publication remains manual; Discord documented as typed projection/control only with no shell, approval, publication, or merge capability
Focused runtime, supervisor, adapter, CLI, launchd, Builder-run, and continuity tests all pass without requiring live Claude API requests
